title: tombino mobs
description: This project makes some mobs faces become a minecraft players face named Tombino
body:
Tombino related stuff

Current features:
some mobs with tombino face
orange concrete with tombino logo
orange bed with tombino skin
banner decoration with tombino logo (skull pattern)

im gonna try to add other stuff too but this is enough

also this is a fan resource pack im not affiliated with tombino in any way and the discord link is not my server its Tombino's
